messages:
mira: quick check  we roll canary snapshots next week - can we include compact per-token + cache-savings metadata? current console only shows aggregate cost delta which hides big cache wins. :eyes:

alex: yes please. for model swaps the token mix changes and its noisy. if we surface 'cache_saved_tokens' and 'tokens_charged' per-variant that should make the canary cost breakdown actionable.

devin: Product also wants an "explain" summary: top cause (token-length vs model-change vs prompt-edit) and a confidence score. keep it lightweight.

ingest-bot: snapshot event recorded for rollout=canary-2026-03-23T09:20Z by @mira

sid: Implementation idea: emit a single snapshot row at snapshot-time, not a timeseries. payload minimal shape: route, variant, invocations, tokens_charged, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, reasons[]. That avoids 1m scrape of all telemetry.

mira: +1. can we make reasons a short enum list and include a freeform note field? e.g., ["model_swap","prompt_shortening"] + "note": "user removed system prompt". keeps UI friendly.

alex: UX suggestion: render a dual-bar per-variant: left = tokens_charged*unit_cost, right = cache_savings visualized as negative spend (green). also toggle between per-invocation and per-token averages. small sparkline for pre/post tokens would help.

devin: For budgets wed like a derived metric "net_delta_per_1k_invocations" to compare canaries of different traffic levels. compute client-side from snapshot fields.

sid: Telemetry contract: backend will accept POST /internal/v1/snapshots with JSON array of snapshot rows. We'll sign the snapshot with rollout_id + timestamp and store immutable blob. retention default 90d, configurable.

mira: Signing + immutability is necessary for enterprise audit trails. Also please store baseline_snapshot_id so we can quickly compute delta without reconstructing history.

alex: sampling question: do we need to change ingestion? I don't want to increase cardinality.

sid: No full re-ingest. Snapshot should be produced by aggregating existing invocation_telemetry on the producer side (canary agent) and sending the compact aggregate. If producer can't aggregate, we allow a sampled sketch but we'll mark it as "approximate": true.

devin: For the heuristics, we can run a simple diff: compare token histograms and prompt-length medians between baseline and canary. If >20% shift in median tokens -> reason: token-length. If model variant id differs -> model-swap. If prompt token overlap < 60% -> prompt-change.

mira: Nice. Will product be okay with heuristic false-positives? they want confidence number.

devin: we'll produce a confidence score computed from sample size and magnitude of shift. simple and explainable.

alex: Accessibility note: when showing the stacked bars, add tooltip with exact cents and token counts. Also expose CSV export of snapshot rows.

sid: Action items: 1) sid to draft POST contract + example payloads (ETA Tue) 2) devin to prototype heuristics code + tests (ETA Wed) 3) alex to mock stacked/csv UX and toggle states (ETA Thu) 4) mira to update rollout runbook and request retention policy (ETA Fri).

mira: I'll shepherd security review for signing and retention.

ingest-bot: canary canary-2026-03-23T09:20Z status: healthy

alex: cool. if we keep payload tiny we can ship fast. prefer: route, variant, invocations, tokens_charged, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_id, reasons[], approx(boolean), note.

sid: ack. I'll post a PR with proto + sample SQL for aggregator:
```
SELECT route, variant, count(*) as invocations, sum(tokens) as tokens_charged,
       sum(cache_saved) as cache_saved_tokens, sum(tokens*unit_price_cents) as token_cost_cents
FROM invocation_telemetry
WHERE rollout_id = :rollout AND snapshot_window = :snapshot_ts
GROUP BY route, variant
```

mira: awesome. let's keep this thread for decisions. will follow-up with the runbook link once updated.

ingest-bot: snapshot compact payload uploaded: 5 rows
